src/components/sections/About/About.css.text:
.about{background:#dcd8ce}.about__layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10%}.about .display{font-size:clamp(90px,9vw,130px);line-height:.95}.about__photo{height:340px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.about__copy h3{font:500 26px/1.75 var(--korean-serif);margin:35px 0 20px;max-width:390px}.about__copy>p{max-width:460px;font-size:16px;line-height:2}.about__qa{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.8fr;gap:8%;margin-top:110px}.about__qa>h3{font:500 52px/1.1 var(--serif)}.about__qa>h3 em{font-weight:400;display:block}.about details{border-top:1px solid #36343466}.about details:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid #36343466}.about summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:26px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}.about summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.about__number{font:16px var(--serif);flex-shrink:0}.about__plus{margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;font:32px/1 var(--serif);transition:transform .3s}.about details[open] .about__plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}.about details>p{padding:0 45px 28px 38px;font-size:16px;line-height:2}
@media(max-width:820px){.about__layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}.about .display{font-size:80px}.about__photo{height:270px}.about__copy h3{font-size:25px}.about__qa{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px;margin-top:65px}.about__qa>h3{font-size:44px}.about__qa>h3 em{display:inline}.about summary{gap:13px;padding:22px 0;font-size:16px}.about details>p{padding-left:30px;padding-right:10px}}

src/components/sections/Closing/Closing..text:
.closing{text-align:center;position:relative;padding-top:155px;padding-bottom:145px;background:var(--paper)}.closing .section-label{justify-content:center}.closing h2{font:500 clamp(54px,7.4vw,110px)/1.04 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em}.closing h2 em{font-weight:400}.closing p{font:19px/2 var(--korean-serif);margin:40px 0 25px}.closing .text-link{min-width:200px}.closing__star{display:block;font-size:50px;font-weight:300;line-height:1;margin-top:60px;color:#7a7364}
@media(max-width:820px){.closing{padding-block:90px}.closing h2{font-size:clamp(36px,8.8vw,70px)}.closing p{font-size:16px;margin-top:30px}.closing__star{margin-top:45px}}

src/components/sections/Profile/Profile..text:
.profile{background:#e9e6de;padding-top:95px}.profile__word{font-size:clamp(72px,10vw,144px);margin-bottom:70px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.profile__word em{font-size:.65em}.profile__layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:12%;align-items:center;max-width:1280px;margin:auto}.profile__photo{aspect-ratio:4/5;max-height:650px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.profile figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font:16px var(--serif);margin-top:16px}.profile figcaption span{font:10px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.05em}.profile__copy .fine-print{letter-spacing:.05em}.profile__copy h2{margin:30px 0;font-size:clamp(26px,2.7vw,39px);line-height:1.75}.profile__copy h2 em{font-style:normal}.profile__copy p{max-width:440px;font-size:16px;line-height:2}.profile__copy .text-link{margin-top:35px;min-width:210px}
@media(max-width:820px){.profile__word{font-size:clamp(42px,10.5vw,72px);margin-bottom:40px}.profile__layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:45px}.profile__photo{max-height:520px}.profile figcaption{font-size:14px}.profile figcaption span{font-size:9px}.profile__copy h2{font-size:28px;margin:20px 0}.profile__copy p{max-width:100%}}
